title: DRDO CEPTAM-11 Tier-II Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Information : Defence Research & Development Organisation (DRDO CEPTAM) has released the Tier-II Admit Card for the recruitment of Senior Technical Assistant-B, Technician-A Posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 764 posts. Applications for the DRDO CEPTAM-11 Recruitment 2026 were accepted from December 11, 2025, to January 11, 2026. The Tier-II  examination is going to conducted on 15 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in Tier-I Examination can download their DRDO CEPTAM-11 Tier-II Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.
applicationFee: Gen / OBC / EWS / MSP : Rs. 750/- (For STA Post)
Gen / OBC / EWS / MSP : Rs. 600/- (For Tech. A Post)

SC / ST / PH / ESM / All Female : Rs. 500/- (For Both Posts)
Fees Refund (After Tier-I Exam)
SC / ST / PH / All Female : Rs. 500/-
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
